query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!: i64",
                  coalesce(max(f.expires_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "tools!: bool"
           FROM jobs j
           LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = j.file_id
           WHERE j.user_id = ? AND j.kind IN ('compress', 'convert')
             AND j.status IN ('queued', 'running')
